overall_assessment: UiO extraction is mostly sound: course_content, learning_outcomes (sub-groups kept), prerequisites and reading_list are correct, and admission text is dropped. The recurring defects are the unmapped Karakterskala sub-heading appended to assessment, and coursework gates (arbeidskrav, reflection notes, obligatory components) left in teaching_methods or assessment instead of coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence:
Karakterskala
Emnet bruker karakterskala fra A til F, der A er beste karakter og F er stryk. Les mer om karakterskalaen.
findings.description: Every UiO assessment row ends with the generic grade-scale boilerplate under a 'Karakterskala' line (sometimes only 'Godkjent/ ikke godkjent.'). This is admin text, not assessment content. In short plans (NOR1000, PROMO8) it is a large share of the section. The packet lists the heading as 'unmapped', while Eksamensspråk and Hjelpemidler are correctly dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The `Karakterskala` sub-heading maps to nothing, so its text is appended to the preceding assessment section instead of being dropped (R/section_heading_map.R).
findings.suggested_fix: Map `Karakterskala` to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R like the sibling Eksamensspråk, Hjelpemidler and Adgang til ny eller utsatt eksamen headings.

findings.evidence:
Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen:
Deltagelse i undervisning
Mikroundervisningskurs
Praksis
Arbeidskrav til eksamen del 1: semesteroppgaven
findings.description: Approval gates written as bold label lines or plain paragraphs under Undervisning stay in teaching_methods: the list of obligatory components in PROF3025 (the pre-pass flag leak->coursework_requirements is real), and in KJM5050 the reflection-note and HMS-course requirements ('Godkjent refleksjonsnotat og bestått praksis er en forutsetning for å gå opp til eksamen'), so KJM5050 gets no coursework_requirements row at all. By the codebook these belong in coursework_requirements. PROF1005 also leaves 'Obligatoriske komponenter / 5 dager obligatorisk praksis' in teaching_methods. Admin lines (Undervisningssted, expenses, Adgang til undervisning) remain in teaching_methods too.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Colon-terminated label lines such as 'Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen:' and 'Obligatoriske komponenter' are not read as headings or not mapped, so the whole Undervisning block becomes one teaching_methods section. Only 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' is recognised, and only when it is a real heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Obligatoriske (forhold|komponenter)' patterns mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R, and let the uio section_* config treat label lines as sub-headings. Map 'Undervisningssted', 'Eventuelle utgifter...' and 'Adgang til undervisning' to .drop.

findings.evidence: For at arbeidskravet skal være bestått, må 75 % av arbeidene som inngår, være godkjent. Nærmere informasjon om arbeidskravene vil være tilgjengelig i Canvas.
findings.description: Arbeidskrav and approval gates sitting under the Eksamen heading stay in assessment (KJM5050 arbeidskrav with 75 % rule and the reflection-note gate; KJM5930L 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter må være godkjent for å kunne gå opp til eksamen'). The codebook puts pass/approve gates in coursework_requirements. These are the real cases behind the pre-pass flags leak->coursework_requirements on both courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No sentence- or paragraph-level move of coursework gates out of assessment for UiO, where gates appear as plain paragraphs without a heading of their own.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the existing whole-item coursework-gate move (#283) to UiO assessment, with patterns such as 'arbeidskrav', 'obligatoriske aktiviteter må være godkjent' and 'forutsetning for å gå opp til'.

findings.evidence: Undervisningsopplegget skal foregå med en skoleklasse på et museum, og skal ha en forarbeidsdel og en etterarbeidsdel på skolen.
findings.description: The pre-pass flag leak->teaching_methods on HIS4015L course_content is a false alarm: the line only starts with the word 'Undervisningsopplegget', not a heading. The course_content text is correct. The separate 'Gjennomføring av praksis' block going to teaching_methods is defensible.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The qa_sections.R leak check matches the prefix 'Undervisning' at line start.
findings.suggested_fix: Require the leak heading match to be a whole line, or word-bounded, in R/audit/qa_sections.R. No pipeline change needed.
